title: M4. Удаление параллельной архитектуры
summary: Удалить старые projectors, trusted HTML, content records и другие обходные пути только после доказанной замены и zero-reference scan.
done_when: Legacy renderers and projectors have no active references.
Public prose is removed from language packs and registry records.
Generated output can be deleted and rebuilt from canonical sources.
Rollback is documented at the commit boundary.
